log.notes_to_self: Day 1: killed national-covered d1-4 and forum-only d1-6,d1-7 plus foreign-only d1-10,d1-11, all quick afternoon. Strategy: limit nonnational exposure to forum and foreign; even if both traced successfully, afternoon-compatible population is 55,000 and pool floor is 3,437.5, safely above 1,000. Keep quick deaths in afternoon to preserve students, night workers, and home routines. Avoid adding regional, hospital, or radio constraints until feedback permits. Two of five source kinds are untraceable, unknown. National-covered victims impose no source restriction. Aim for 6-8 daily kills when available to reach rolling-five-day multipliers, without adding dangerous source or routine constraints.

Even if both forum and foreign are traceable, these constraints leave at least 100000*0.55*0.25*0.25=3437.5 suspects, safely above 1000. Do not add South-only, hospital-only, or radio-only victims: another independent constraint could push the pool below 1000. Unknown two untraceable source kinds; wait for press feedback after day 3. Aim for at least 30, ideally 40 kills per rolling five days without compromising the safe pool floor.
